youtube_title: Why does God feel far away? | Psalm 10
youtube_description:
Why does God feel far away when everything is falling apart? Psalm 10 opens with that exact question: "Why, O LORD, do you stand far away?" (Psalm 10:1)

The wicked man tells himself God has forgotten and will never see (Psalm 10:11). The psalm answers him with one Hebrew word: ra'itah (rah-EE-tah), "you have seen" (Psalm 10:14). God hears the desire of the afflicted and brings justice to the fatherless and the oppressed (Psalm 10:17-18).

Today's step: bring God your honest "why." He can handle the question.

Day 10 of the Psalms, one chapter a day. Follow @thebibleexplainedai so you don't miss Psalm 11.

Read it: Psalm 10:1-18
